fusions.name: Cast the Weave
fusions.desc: Throws a knotted line that deals 12 damage and has a 40% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Drawn Shut
fusions.desc: Pulls the tines tight in a ring, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and [Slowing] them for 4 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Gathered In
fusions.desc: Hauls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Runner
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
